title: Writing: A Story from My Family History
writingModel: Last summer, I visited my grandfather in his village. He is 80 years old and he told me an amazing story from his youth. When he was young, he worked on a collective farm in the 1960s. Life was very hard. He woke up at five o'clock every morning and worked until sunset. He didn't have a tractor — he used horses.

One winter, there was a terrible snowstorm. The animals got cold and hungry. My grandfather and his neighbours worked all night to protect them. They didn't sleep at all. By morning, all the animals were safe. The village leader was so impressed that he gave my grandfather a special certificate.

I found this certificate in an old box in the attic. It was yellow and old, but I could still read the words. I felt so proud of my grandfather. His story taught me that hard work and community spirit can overcome any difficulty. Now I keep this certificate on my wall as a reminder of our family history.
